entries.title: Sophos cuts threat investigation time by 96% with OpenAI Daybreak
entries.summary: Discover how Sophos uses OpenAI’s Daybreak to cut cyber-threat investigation time by 96% and automate 52% of MDR cases while preserving human oversight.

entries.title: How Oracle turns days of work into minutes with ChatGPT and Codex
entries.summary: Across recruiting, engineering, and operations, Oracle turns specialist knowledge into fast, repeatable workflows with ChatGPT Work and Codex.

entries.title: Pollo AI turns creative ideas into campaigns with OpenAI
entries.summary: With GPT-5.6, GPT-6 Astra, and GPT‑Image‑2.5, Pollo AI helps creators turn bold ideas into detailed images and cinematic video ads.

entries.title: LegalOn halves Codex costs while maintaining development speed
entries.summary: LegalOn cut estimated daily Codex costs by 65% while maintaining development speed. It matched Astra, Sol, and Luna to tasks and managed budgets strategically.

entries.title: Disrupting AI-enabled “false front” operations
entries.summary: OpenAI disrupted two AI-enabled influence operations that used false-front journalists and a think tank to spread geopolitical messaging.

entries.title: Helping teens learn, plan, and shape the future of AI
entries.summary: College Planner is coming to ChatGPT for Teens to help students manage college applications, alongside new flashcards, quizzes, and a teen AI council.

entries.title: Radisson Hotel Group brings hotel discovery into ChatGPT
entries.summary: Radisson partnered with Accenture to build a ChatGPT plugin using OpenAI technology, helping travelers find, compare, and book hotels while planning their trips.

entries.title: GPT-6 and Intelligent UI for everyone
entries.summary: GPT‑6 is rolling out globally in ChatGPT with Intelligent UI, delivering faster responses with visuals and interactive experiences you can explore and use directly.

entries.title: How Jump Trading is scaling quant research with ChatGPT
entries.summary: Jump Trading uses OpenAI to expand quantitative research. See how longer-running AI workflows combine multiple data sources with human review.

entries.title: Sharing AI progress in mathematics
entries.summary: OpenAI publishes new results on open problems in mathematics from an internal frontier model and shares Lean proof formalizations and research details on GitHub.
